name: files
description: Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, organize, and serve an evidence vault. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (files-serve) + generated SDK. The client uses the hosted HTTP API when HASNA_FILES_API_URL + HASNA_FILES_API_KEY are set, else local SQLite; files-serve uses PostgreSQL when HASNA_FILES_DATABASE_URL is set, with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts; file bytes stay in S3.
